basic.summary: The hard part of production ML isn't the model. It's keeping it reliable as data, traffic, and edge cases pile up. That reliability-first instinct runs through everything I build, and a period of U.S. Army service only sharpened it: stay composed, assume things break, plan for the failure case. I've made it a specialty across large-scale LLM platforms, multi-agent systems, multimodal RAG, and ranking, delivered across healthcare RCM, ad-tech, and identity verification, most recently advertiser-copilot orchestration at Meta. Most drawn to generative AI, retrieval, and agentic workflows.

experience.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer | NLP Specialist
bullets: Contributed to multi-agent LLM systems to enhance the conversational advertiser copilot, streamlining workflows across campaign management and creative optimization, enabling intelligent automation and improving advertiser efficiency.
Built AI-powered assistants for advertiser support agents, reducing case resolution time and improving advertiser satisfaction by enabling faster and more accurate responses.
Built the copilot's retrieval layer on Meta's embedding-search infrastructure, enabling semantic lookup over ad-platform objects and unstructured advertiser data.
Modeled advertiser–campaign–audience relationships on the knowledge graph infrastructure to drive policy-aware, contextual recommendations in the copilot.
Built multi-turn tool-call extraction model using fine-tuned Llama + Transformers, predicting normalized API calls from prior turns + intermediate tool outputs.
Engineered and versioned the copilot's system and tool-calling prompts, improving task success and reducing malformed tool calls.
Built the copilot's evaluation stack including offline metrics, regression suites, LLM-as-judge, human review, and online A/B to gate model and prompt changes.
Trained models with PyTorch + PEFT + LoRA + TRL, served via vLLM for low-latency structured inference.
Collaborated with cross-functional teams to align ML solutions with business goals in ad delivery, operations, and advertiser experience.
Improved data quality through validation frameworks and automated pipeline checks across ingestion systems.
Improved model performance through advanced feature engineering, hyperparameter tuning, and A/B testing across production systems.
Deployed ML models as scalable microservices for low-latency, real-time inference serving advertiser interactions.
Built batch and real-time data pipelines on Spark and Presto, orchestrated in Dataswarm, to support campaign analytics and advertiser reporting.

experience.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer | Data Scientist
bullets: Built an end-to-end medical documentation platform that turned visits into SOAP notes, predicted billing codes via multi-label classification, and integrated with EHR systems like Epic.

Developed multi-label models to assign ICD-10 codes from clinical documentation across a label space of tens of thousands of codes, combining fine-tuned NLP models with retrieval over coding guidelines.
Trained regression models predicting expected reimbursement per claim from payer, plan, service, and contract terms, powering revenue forecasting and anomaly-based underpayment detection.
Designed and deployed real-time inference systems on GKE, Vertex AI, and Cloud Run, delivering low-latency outputs to clinical workflows.
Migrated the orchestrator to Java with gRPC, modernizing a low-latency service for high-frequency clinical event processing.
Built scalable ETL pipelines for clinical, claims, and patient datasets on GCP using Dataflow, Dataproc, and GCS.
Stood up a HIPAA-eligible clinical data lake on GCS with Dataplex for governed, auditable access to PHI.
Led LLM fine-tuning for domain-specific medical language on Vertex AI, improving response relevance and contextual understanding in clinical interactions.
Used Vertex AI and Gemini to prototype and serve foundation-model features, applying built-in safety filters to keep PHI-sensitive clinical text compliant.
Built multimodal pipelines combining text, documents, and attachments to enable unified clinical intelligence and richer downstream analytics.
Deployed large-scale LLM inference with vLLM on A2/A3 GPU instances across GCE and GKE to power real-time, high-throughput AI features in clinician-facing applications.
Reduced inference latency and infrastructure cost through model optimization, batching, and right-sizing of GPU instances.
Built a feature store on Vertex AI Feature Store supporting real-time and batch feature serving for clinical prediction models.
Automated document processing for clinical records, claims, and prior authorizations with Document AI and LLM-based extraction, orchestrated via Cloud Functions and Cloud Workflows.
Established end-to-end MLOps pipelines on GCP using Vertex AI Pipelines, GKE, and Cloud Composer for continuous training, deployment, and monitoring of ML systems.
Built observability and monitoring frameworks for ML systems using Cloud Monitoring and Cloud Logging with Datadog.
Standardized ML workflows across teams using Kubeflow on GKE, improving reproducibility and cross-team collaboration.
Led MLOps initiatives to standardize deployment, monitoring, and governance practices across ML systems.
Integrated structured and unstructured data across storage systems including Snowflake, Cloud SQL for PostgreSQL, and Memorystore for Redis.
Designed CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, Git, and Cloud Build to automate model deployment and versioning across environments.
Containerized ML applications with Docker and orchestrated deployments via GKE for high availability.
Built and maintained FastAPI/gRPC microservices to support scalable, highly available ML serving.
Optimized distributed data processing on Dataproc, improving performance and reducing infrastructure costs.

experience.title: Army Service Member
bullets: Served on active duty in the U.S. Army, building discipline, accountability, and adaptability in high-pressure, structured environments, with hands-on experience in logistics coordination and operational planning.

experience.title: Software Engineer
bullets: Built a KYC identity-verification and onboarding system using OCR and face recognition, enabling photo-ID matching and liveness detection while reducing manual checks by 40%.
Trained real-time fraud-scoring models in TensorFlow and PyTorch to detect anomalies across uploaded documents and profile data, improving KYC approval accuracy by 35%.
Developed document-classification pipelines with Scikit-learn to identify document types and flag tampered scans.
Used pre-trained VGGFace2 models in PyTorch to embed and compare facial features during live onboarding.
Optimized latency-critical face-recognition and OCR components in C++, improving throughput and reducing processing latency.
Built CTR/CVR prediction models for Baidu's feed and search-ad ranking on the PaddlePaddle stack.
Developed two-tower embedding models for candidate generation and retrieval.
Designed re-ranking systems balancing relevance, diversity, and revenue.
Built scalable ETL pipelines for ingesting and transforming large-scale event and user-interaction datasets.

experience.title: Backend Developer
bullets: Designed, developed, and maintained scalable backend services and RESTful APIs using Java and Spring, supporting high-volume enterprise applications and improving system performance.

Collaborated with cross-functional teams to optimize database queries, troubleshoot production issues, and implement secure, reliable solutions that enhanced application stability and user experience.
